translations.web: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
